BE IT ORDAINED BT THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITV OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. That Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
be amended by changing all ofthe M3-3 Heavy Industry District symbols and indications as
shown on Map 5-G in the area bounded by

       West Wabansia Avenue; North Elston Avenue; a line 125.42 feet southeasterly of
       and parallel to West Wabansia Avenue; and North Besly Court

                                               M3-3 to C3-3T1

      Applicant:                    Litton Adventures, LLC
      Property Address:             1690 N. Elston Avenue
      Proposed Zoning:              C3-3T1 Commercial, Manufacturing and Employment Districl

 I.       NARRATIVE
      The property is improved with an existing 2-story, 17,470 sq. ft., 30.0' high building. The
      Applicant is seeking the rezoning in order to enlarge the building to a total floor area of 36,920
      square feet. There will be no increase in height. There will be 8 accessory vehicle parking spaces
      and 42 non-accessory parking spaces.

      The parcel is located within the North Branch Corridor Overlay - Subdistrict A. Pursuant to 17-
      3-0400 for the rezoning of M-zoned land within an industrial coiridor, to a zoning district other
      than M, or a P.M.D., P.O.S. or T, the matter will bc referred to the Chicago Plan Commission.

       3) Off-street Parking and Loading:

          b) Side(N)                                0.0'
          c) Side(S)                                0.0'
          d) Rear                                   0.0'

                                         ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE C I T Y COUNCIL O F THE C I T Y O F CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. That Titie 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
be amended by changing all ofthe M3-3 Heavy Industry District symbols and indications as
shown on Map 5-G in the area bounded by

       West Wabansia Avenue; North Elston Avenue; a line 125.42 feet southeasterly of
       and parallel to West Wabansia Avenue; and the alley next southwesterly of and
       parallel to North Besly Court

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and

Address: 1690 North Elston Avenue
                                           1690 N. Elston Avenue
                                            Narrative and Plans
                                      Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment

                                                 M3-3 to C3-2T1

      Applicant:                    Litton Adventures, LLC
      Property Address:             1690 N. Elston Avenue
      Proposed Zoning:              C3-2T] Commercial, Manufacturing and Employment District.

 I.        NARRATIVE
      The property is improved with an existing 2-story, 17,395 sq. ft., 30.0' high building. The
      Applicant is seeking the rezoning in order to enlarge the building to a total floor area of 25,251
      square feet There will be no increase in height. There will be 50 vehicle parking spaces. The site
      is 1,095 feet from the North Avenue stop ofthe CTA No. 9 Ashland bus route, establishing this
      as a transit-served location and thereby reducing the building's parking requirement to 0.

      The building permit for a two-story atrium addition and 16-space parking lot is currently being
      reviewed. This will be the first phase of the building's enlargement. The proposed zoning will
      allow the further expansion as a second phase of development.

      The parcel is located within the North Branch Corridor Overlay - Subdistrict A. Pursuant to 17-
      3-0400 for the rezoning of M-zoned land within an industrial corridor, to a zoning district other
      than M, or a P.M.D., P.O.S. or T, the matter will be referred to the Chicago Plan Commission.


II.      ZONING ANALYSIS

       1) Floor Area and Fioor Area Ratio
          a) Lot Area                                17,625 sq. ft.
          b) Total building area                     25,251 sq.ft.
          c) FAR                                      1.43

      2) Density (lot area per dwelling unit):       Not applicable

      3) Off-street Parking and Loading:
         a) Parking                                  50 vehicular parking spaces
         b) Loading                                  1 10' X 25' loading berth

      4) Setbacks:
             i) Front                                0.0'
             ii) Side(N)                             0.0'
             iii) Side (S)                           0.0'
             iv) Rear                                0.0'

      5) Building Height:                            30.0' - 2 stories
